name: ClayAnimation.Redmond (SDXL)
means: Fills the SET with clay objects. It does not make the SUBJECT out of clay. If you want a plasticine character, route the shot to FLUX.2.
verdict: IT LOADS PERFECTLY AND IT STILL DOES NOT DO THE JOB - the most instructive result in this intake. Zero unloaded keys. Three ladders: animagine at 0 / 0.6 / 0.9 / 1.2, animagine at 0 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5, Illustrious at 0 / 0.9 / 1.5 / 2.0, one seed each, trigger in every cell. The image moves at every step - the counter and shelves fill with clay pots, clay figurines and modelled animals, and the palette warms. The WOMAN never changes medium. At 2.5 on animagine she is still a cel-shaded anime character standing in a room full of clay ornaments. Same on Illustrious at 2.0. THIS IS THE PROJECT'S OWN NOUN-AS-PROP LAW, reproduced by a LoRA instead of by a prompt: asking for a material got the material drawn as scenery. Compare FLUX.2's claymation cell in cross_flux2.jpg - an actual plasticine puppet with fingerprints. NOT RECOMMENDED for claymation.
note: THE GATE THIS WAS BOUGHT AGAINST. studio/_tools/model_intake.py rendered eleven style probes on four installed engines before anything was downloaded (samples/model_intake/base_animagine-xl-4.jpg, base_Illustrious-XL-v2.jpg, cross_flux2.jpg, cross_qwen.jpg). Ten of the eleven were already covered: animagine renders pixel art, coloring-book lineart and a genuine watercolour from tags; Illustrious renders real painterly oil that animagine cannot; FLUX.2 renders claymation, woodcut, comic halftone, low-poly PS1, watercolour and photography outright; Qwen renders photography and nothing else - every probe came back a photograph, exactly as the project's standing rule says. WHY IT PROBABLY FAILS, unverified: it is a delta on base SDXL 1.0 and both of our SDXL checkpoints are heavy ANIME finetunes. The anime prior for 'a person' appears to survive anything this LoRA does to it, while the prior for 'objects on a counter' does not. That predicts the same outcome for any base-SDXL style LoRA that has to restyle a FIGURE, and it is the single most useful thing this intake learned about the shortlist - it is a reason to doubt the whole 'buy SDXL style LoRAs' lane, not just this file. example_note: Left cell is the control at strength 0 and the trigger phrase is in that cell too, so strength is the only variable. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights - a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing, the OFF cell is the evidence.
